parameters.help_en: The extended request parameter in the JSON format
parameters.help_zh: 扩展请求参数，JSON格式
parameters.name: request_pars

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The format of the configurations. Supported formats include TEXT, JSON, XML, and HTML
parameters.help_zh: 配置格式，包括TEXT、JSON、XML、HTML等
parameters.name: config_type

parameters.help_en: The time unit. This parameter is valid for ZooKeeper instances. Default value: 2000. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: zookeeper配置，时间单元，默认为2000毫秒
parameters.name: tick_time

parameters.help_en: The maximum connection duration of the instance. This parameter is valid for ZooKeeper instances. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: zookeeper配置，实例最长连接时间，单位：秒
parameters.name: init_limit

parameters.help_en: The connection timeout period of the instance. This parameter is valid for ZooKeeper instances. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: zookeeper配置，实例连接超时时间，单位：秒
parameters.name: sync_limit

parameters.help_en:
The number of connections between a single client and a single server in ZooKeeper configuration.
If this parameter is set to 0, no limits are imposed on the number of connections.
parameters.help_zh:
zookeeper配置，单个客户端与单台服务器之间的连接数。  
如果设置为0，表示不作任何限制
parameters.name: max_client_cnxns

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether super permissions are enabled. This parameter is valid for ZooKeeper instances. Valid values:

`true`: enabled

`false`: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
zookeeper配置，超级权限开关，取值如下：
`true`：打开
`false`：关闭
parameters.name: open_super_acl

parameters.help_en:
The username of the account.

This parameter is required when OpenSuperAcl is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
用户名称。
当OpenSuperAcl为true时，需要填写此值
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en:
The password of the account.

This parameter is required when OpenSuperAcl is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
用户密码。
当OpenSuperAcl为true时，需要填写此值
parameters.name: pass_word

parameters.help_en: The maximum amount of data on each node. This parameter is valid for ZooKeeper instances. Unit: bytes
parameters.help_zh: zookeeper配置，每个节点最大数据量，默认是1M，单位：字节
parameters.name: jute_maxbuffer

parameters.name: autopurge_purge_interval

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable RAM authentication for the configuration center in Nacos:

`true`: enabled

`false`: disabled

Before you set this parameter, call the QueryConfig operation to obtain the ConfigAuthSupported parameter to check whether the current cluster supports this feature
parameters.help_zh:
nacos配置，是否开启配置中心ram鉴权：
`true`：开启
`false`：关闭

设置此值前需要调用QueryConfig接口，获取ConfigAuthSupported参数，以查看当前集群是否支持此功能
parameters.name: config_auth_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable RAM authentication for the Accreditation Centre in Nacos:

`true`: enabled

`false`: disabled

Before you set this parameter, call the QueryConfig operation to obtain the NamingAuthSupporte parameter to check whether the current cluster supports this feature
parameters.help_zh:
nacos配置，是否开启注册中心ram鉴权：
`true`：开启
`false`：关闭

设置此值前需要调用QueryConfig接口，获取NamingAuthSupporte参数，以查看当前集群是否支持此功能
parameters.name: naming_auth_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether MCP is enabled in Nacos configuration. Valid values:

`true`: enabled

`false`: disabled

Before you set this parameter, call the QueryConfig operation to obtain the MCPSupported parameter to check whether the current cluster supports this feature
parameters.help_zh:
nacos配置，MCP是否生效，取值如下：
`true`：生效
`false`：不生效
设置此值前需要调用QueryConfig接口，获取MCPSupported参数，以查看当前集群是否支持此功能
parameters.name: mcp_enabled

parameters.help_en: The instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the configuration encryption feature for the configuration center in Nacos. Valid values:

`true`: The request was successful.

`false`: The request failed.

Before you set this parameter, call the QueryConfig operation to obtain the ConfigSecretSupported parameter to check whether the current cluster supports this feature
parameters.help_zh:
nacos配置，是否打开配置中心配置加密功能，取值如下：
`true`：请求成功。
`false`：请求失败。

设置此值前需要调用QueryConfig接口，获取ConfigSecretSupported参数，以查看当前集群是否支持此功能
parameters.name: config_secret_enabled

parameters.help_en: The minimum timeout period in ZooKeeper configuration. Unit: seconds

parameters.name: min_session_timeout

parameters.help_en: The maximum timeout period in ZooKeeper configuration. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: zookeeper配置，最大超时时间，单位：秒
parameters.name: max_session_timeout

parameters.name: extended_types_enable

parameters.help_zh: Nacos是否开启支持Eurka协议
parameters.name: eureka_supported

parameters.name: tls_enabled
